verdict.rationale: Evidence documents CPU optimizations for x86 (AVX/AVX2/AVX512/AMX) and ARM (NEON/Metal/Accelerate) and touts a dependency-free plain C/C++ implementation, but there is no mention of PowerPC or other non-x86/ARM architectures anywhere in the pack. missing for 10: any documentation, build target, or community report of PowerPC (or other exotic CPU architecture) support.
